mapper.sql: id, public_no, user_id, amount, available_before, available_after, reason, request_id, created_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ledger_test_credit (public_no, user_id, amount, available_before, available_after, reason, request_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{availableBefore}, #{availableAfter}, #{reason}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: id, public_no, user_id, direction, category, amount, available_before, available_after, ref_no, reason, over_limit, request_id, created_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ledger_adjust (public_no, user_id, direction, category, amount, available_before, available_after, ref_no, reason, over_limit, request_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{userId}, #{direction}, #{category}, #{amount}, #{availableBefore}, #{availableAfter}, #{refNo}, #{reason}, #{overLimit}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ledger_adjust ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'CREDIT' THEN amount END), 0) AS credit, COUNT(CASE WHEN direction = 'CREDIT' THEN 1 END) AS credits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'DEBIT' THEN amount END), 0) AS debit, COUNT(CASE WHEN direction = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 END) AS debits FROM ledger_adjust WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day
SELECT FROM ledger_adjust WHERE id > #{afterId} AND direction = 'CREDIT' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM ledger_adjust WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND direction = 'CREDIT' AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at <= #{to} AND id <= #{upToId}
